method: ci-run-linux-<request-id> temporary snapshot pushed to existing workflow, cleanup by existing job; do not create a new workflow/controller
authorized_scope: documentation-only preflight; product CI 101 and compiler/guards 45 retain their separate authority
run_constraints: No local tests/checks or Python execution
No new workflow, no product tests, no second scheduler
One causal request, source SHA+tree+normalized request evidence
Do not claim GO on green preflight; N0 independent review and leases still required

canonical_materialization.strategy: GitHub Actions only: git fetch exact pinned canonical commit, git show exact campaign blob into ephemeral temp file
canonical_materialization.behavior: Fail closed on missing object, hash mismatch, empty content or git fetch errors; do not mutate the PR99 tree
